query:
SELECT 
  b.id,
  b.vesselId,
  b.startTime,
  b.endTime,
  b.status,
  u.name as clientName,
  u.email as clientEmail,
  v.name as vesselName
FROM bookings b
JOIN users u ON b.userId = u.id
JOIN vessels v ON b.vesselId = v.id
WHERE (b.status = 'confirmed' OR b.status = 'used')
ORDER BY b.endTime DESC
LIMIT 10;
